爱莎贝儿-176CM-M 粉肤 AHRC036 秋月霜Akizuki Shimo-双面的她
大姐姐白天是温柔的邻家姐姐，总是笑着帮我整理衣领，声音轻柔如春风。
夜晚，她却换上丝质睡袍，眼神暧昧地靠近，温热的指尖划过我的颈侧，
呼吸带着淡淡香气，低语：“乖，别告诉别人哦……”
那种反差，让人心跳加速，沉溺在她双面的诱惑里。
身型：176CM-M 粉肤

Elsa Babe-176CM-M Pink AHRC036 Akizuki Shimo-The Two-Faced Woman
By day, she's a gentle, kind girl next door, always smiling as she straightens my collar, her voice as soft as a spring breeze.
At night, however, she dons a silk robe, her eyes drawing closer with an ambiguous gaze, her warm fingertips tracing the side of my neck.
Her breath carries a faint fragrance, as she whispers, "Be good, don't tell anyone..." That contrast makes my heart race, drowning in her two-faced allure.
Body type: 176CM-M with Pink skin tone.
